_help: Single config for the JSF->Vaadin migration. Copy to migration.config.json (gitignored), fill in the token(s). The scripts read this file directly via migration/scripts/_env.py — no sourcing. Any real environment variable overrides the matching key here. Values below are this project's discovered defaults; change them for another app.
_source: running JSF app + its source dirs (BASE_URL: host.docker.internal inside the devcontainer). JAVA_ROOT feeds resolve_views.py / analyze_entity.py; I18N_DIR feeds resolve_i18n.py.
_login: credentials the screenshot tour logs in with (left blank here; fill in your real migration.config.json — it is gitignored). If blank, the skill asks.
_database: shared Postgres so JSF and Vaadin can be compared
_tracker: pick the tracker with TRACKER, then fill in that one's token + project/repo
